name: Zoom
summary: An unpublished General app works only for users in your own Zoom account. To let other accounts connect, the app has to pass Marketplace review (functional, then security), or get approval to share a beta link, which needs SAST/DAST evidence. Expect weeks, and few apps pass on the first try.

composio.note: Composio provides a managed OAuth app, so you can ship without registering your own. Bring your own app for your brand on the consent screen, custom scopes, or your own rate limits.

steps.title: Create a General app
steps.detail: Marketplace → Develop → Build App → General app. Choose user-managed (each user authorizes) or admin-managed (account-wide).
steps.agent: Recommend user- vs admin-managed from your scopes
steps.human: Create it while signed in to the Zoom developer account

steps.title: Add scopes with a justification for each
steps.detail: Each scope is a request to Zoom's Security Review team, which rejects anything that isn't needed. Add the OAuth redirect URL (Composio BYO: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback) and allow-list it.
steps.agent: Choose the minimal granular scopes and write a justification for each

steps.title: Verify your domains
steps.detail: Privacy policy, terms, redirect, webhook and home URLs must all be on domains you verify in the build flow.

steps.title: Prepare the security documentation
steps.detail: SSDLC doc, SAST and DAST scan output (real scanner output, not summaries), privacy policy, plus 3 of: pentest summary, security policy, incident response, vulnerability management, dependency policy. TLS 1.2+.
steps.agent: Run SAST/DAST scans and draft the policies
steps.human: Approve the policies and commission a pentest if needed

steps.title: Submit for review (functional → security)
steps.detail: Give test account credentials and reviewer notes. Zoom says few apps pass on the first attempt.
steps.agent: Write the reviewer notes and test plan

launchToday: Composio-managed Zoom auth lets external users connect today.
Build and dogfood inside your own Zoom account. No review needed.
Start the security pack (SAST/DAST, policies) now. It's the long pole.
rejections: Scopes broader than the feature needs
Scan evidence submitted as written summaries, not scanner output
Redirect or webhook URLs on unverified domains
No working test account for the reviewer

blockers.problem: Users from another company get an error installing
blockers.fix: The app is unpublished. Publish it (or get beta sharing approved) through review, or use Composio-managed auth meanwhile.

blockers.problem: Account admin must approve the app
blockers.fix: Many accounts require admin pre-approval in Marketplace settings. Send the admin your listing link.

uncertain: Zoom doesn't publish review turnaround. 2–6 weeks is an estimate from developer reports.
